Actually the sulfonyl chloride part is attached to aromatic ring with aldehyde. So the reaction: aromatic amine + aryl sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. The second SMILES O=C(O)CC(=O)O is maybe a reagent? Not sure.

Might be a separate product? Could be the template also includes a carboxylic acid? Not sure.
